---
title: "Scanr harvester"
---

🧭 Back to [Harvesters Overview](overview.qmd)

> ⚠️ The ScanR harvester requires identifiers and credentials for the ScanR API (currently under restricted access):
>
> 1. Obtain identifiers, credentials, and host from ScanR.
> 2. Add them to the harvester's environment as `SCANR_ES_USER`, `SCANR_ES_PASSWORD`, and `SCANR_ES_HOST`.

## Data source

The ScanR harvester fetches data from the latest ScanR API.

## Supported identifiers

- idref
- orcid
- idhals

> ℹ️ When `idref` is unavailable, the harvester falls back to `orcid` or `idhals` to gather the entity's data. It
> then derives the internal `scanr_id` from the `idref`, enabling retrieval of the entity's publications from the
> ScanR API.

## Data conversion

ScanR document types and author qualities are mapped to RDF classes following the table provided in the
[CRISalid data model documentation](https://www.esup-portail.org/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1352335371#GECMod%C3%A9lisation-MappingScanr-SoVisu+).
